linkedin.about: Mel Robbins is the creator and host of the award-winning The Mel Robbins Podcast, one of the most successful podcasts in the world, and a #1 New York Times bestselling author of The Let Them Theory. She's also the founder and CEO of the media production company 143 Studios. She has amassed 40 million followers online and is one of the most respected experts in mindset, life improvement, and behavior change. The Wall Street Journal calls her a “billion-view podcaster” and TIME Magazine says she gives millions of listeners around the globe “a reason to believe in themselves.” Her books have been translated into 63 languages and include the #1 New York Times, #1 Amazon, #1 Audible, and #1 Sunday Times bestselling The Let Them Theory, which is the top selling book of 2025 according to Publisher’s Weekly, with 7 million copies sold within nine months of its release date. It is on pace to have the best non-fiction book launch of all time. She is also the author of the multimillion-copy-selling The 5 Second Rule, The High 5 Habit, and seven #1 audiobook releases on Audible. USA Today calls Mel “a force to be reckoned with.” She is a global phenomenon in the publishing industry and podcasting. Her Boston-based media production company, 143 Studios, produces award-winning content, podcasts, events, audio series, online courses, journals, and books, along with professional development education forpartners likeStarbucks, Ulta Beauty, JP Morgan Chase, LinkedIn, Headspace, and Audible. The Mel Robbins Podcast has won some of the most prestigious awards given to podcasts, including Webby, Signal Awards, and iHeart. It was also recognized as one of Apple Podcasts' Top Shared and Followed Shows of 2024 and 2023 and Spotify Top Global Shows of 2024. Notable accolades for Robbins include being named to Time 100 Most Influential Digital Voices of 2025, a Forbes 50 Over 50 Honoree, USA Today Top 5 Mindset & Performance Coaches in the World, and one of the fifty most influential influencers on The Hollywood Reporter’s Creator A-List in 2024. Thanks for being here! Learn more at melrobbins.com. Reach my team: Press inquiries: TeamMelRobbins@align-pr.com Speaking inquiries: darrin@powellspeakers.com Brand partnership inquiries: MelRobbinsTeam@unitedtalent.com

linkedin.activityText: Activity 2M followers Posts Comments No more previous content Mel Robbins Mel Robbins 16h Mel Robbins shared this One of the hardest things about changing your life is looking at everything you’ve already invested in the life you have. The degree. The years you’ve spent building a career. The title you worked so hard to earn. The experience. The expectations other people now have of you. And then there’s this little voice inside you saying: “I don't think I want this anymore.” That can be terrifying. Because now changing direction feels like throwing all of that time away. But what if none of it was wasted? What if the job you hate, the rejection you’re still embarrassed about, the wrong turn, the thing that didn’t work out, or the years you spent becoming someone you no longer want to be... ...are all part of what prepares you for whatever comes next? Tomorrow morning, I’m sending you a tool for anyone who feels stuck in a chapter of their life they’re ready to outgrow. I learned it from someone whose own path was anything but straightforward, and who reinvented himself ten times over. He failed English. Changed colleges three times. Became a lawyer. Went into politics. Started writing. Had his first book rejected by 28 publishers. And then kept going - and went on to become one of the most prolific and successful writers of our time (he’s the guy I’m talking to in this photo). Tomorrow morning in my newsletter, I’m sharing what his story taught me about reinvention, and how you can start creating your own next chapter. You’ll learn: - Why rejection is not necessarily a sign to quit - How to make room for a dream when your life is already full - What to do when you have no idea what your next move should be - Why studying someone you admire can help you find your own way forward - And how to recognize what he calls a “golden moment” - a moment that becomes the catalyst for a whole new chapter of your life Here’s what I hope you take away from it: You are allowed to become someone you didn’t plan on becoming. And you don’t need to have the entire next chapter figured out before you start writing it. Sometimes you just need to write the first page. Send this quote to your daughter to remind her to apologize less, take up more space and dream louder than you did at her age. ❤️

My daughters are in their 20s and I hope they stop questioning their intuition every time it tells them something important.

I hope they walk away from jobs and relationships sooner, because the longer you stay in something that’s not meant for you, the more you end up hurting yourself. 

I hope they ask for help, instead of suffering in silence like I so often did. 

Every lesson I learned through heartbreak, disappointment and self-doubt is a lesson I know that each and everyone of us must learn… 

But if I could wave a magic wand 🪄 I would wish for my daughters to learn these life lessons in years (not the decades it took me) because learning how to trust and love yourself that’s one of the greatest gifts anyone could receive. 

❤️
